title.small: Every feature, in about a minute.

new.text: Everything since you last looked is New. The rest steps back to Earlier.

check.text: Open the panel and close it. What it showed moves to Earlier.

arrive.text: A new message lands on top and brings its chat back to New.

chat.text: A chat stacks up. Tap it to read every message.

preview.text: Press and hold any card for a Preview, without opening the app.

viewer.text: Tap the photo to see it full screen. Zoom, save or share.

swipe.text: Swipe one message out of a chat. Only that message goes.

burst.text: A burst from one app folds into a stack, still in time order.

media.text: Music stays on top, with play, pause and a seek bar.

running.text: Always-running services fold into one pill.

clear.text: Clear sweeps Earlier away. Music and Running stay.

lock.text: When the screen turns on, what’s new is up front. No unlocking.

privacy.small: Your notifications never leave your phone. No accounts, no analytics, no backend.

open.small: Free, GPL-3.0. Read every line, change it, build it yourself.

feedback.small: Ideas or bugs? Tell us. Chronotif gets better from what you report.
